result.summary: Corrected lib/letflow/design/iss0442-lint-handoffs-minimal-diff-autofix.md section 1.1 only. Re-verified directly against the vendored dependency (not inherited): deps/jason/CHANGELOG.md shows Jason.OrderedObject shipped in 1.3.0 (21.12.2021), three minor versions before the pinned 1.4.5; deps/jason/lib/ordered_object.ex fully implements it; deps/jason/lib/jason.ex documents the `objects: :ordered_objects` decode option; deps/jason/lib/encode.ex implements the Jason.Encoder clause for the struct. Rewrote the version-check paragraph to state this correctly, and explicitly noted that an earlier draft claimed the opposite, that this was checked here and found false, so a future reader doesn't have to re-derive it themselves. Re-grounded the rejection of option (a) entirely on grounds that don't depend on version availability: effect (2) (pretty-print reflow) is untouched by key order because Jason.encode!(data, pretty: true) always compact-encodes first and then reformats via Jason.Formatter.pretty_print_to_iodata unconditionally (cited deps/jason/lib/jason.ex:217-226 and deps/jason/lib/formatter.ex, matching the validator's own verification), plus the pre-existing decode-shape-fork argument (Jason.OrderedObject.decode!/1 yields a distinct struct, forcing either a second decode shape across autofix_file/1 and the H1-H4 checks, or a second separate decode call scoped only to the write path). No other section touched: left section 1.2 (option c), section 1.3/section 2 (recommendation and depth-tracking algorithm), section 3 (preserved refusal/no-flag-CI behavior), and section 4 (open questions) exactly as they were -- confirmed via diff that only the lines within section 1.1's version-check and rejection paragraphs changed.
